title: Search provider 1.0
description: FreeScoutInterop.search.registerProvider() (bridge protocol 1.1) and the server filter fsinterop.search.providers: a module that can search tickets in a context. The module that owns the search UI of that context lists the providers and runs them; handler(request) receives {query, limit} and returns a Promise of search results 1.0.

context.description: search context, e.g. global-mailboxes, or * for every context

endpoint.description: GET URL answering ?q=&limit= with search results 1.0, for the logged-in user

handler.description: browser only: function (request) returning a Promise, not serializable
